outcome: prevalence of SARS-CoV-2 IgG antibody response
cohort: The participants were 529 pregnant women admitted for delivery at a single perinatal center in the Paris area.
finding: The seroprevalence of SARS-CoV-2 IgG in pregnant women at the time of delivery was found to be low (4.7%).
cross-section timing: at the time of delivery, between April 29 and June 26
